market_mood.explanation_en: The 71.3 regime score is like a boat rowing with one oar in calm water but facing a headwind — progress is possible but effortful. For someone deciding whether to buy stocks today it signals selective buying is reasonable but position sizing should stay modest until oil and yields stabilize.

big_picture.summary_en: Brent crude topped $101 per barrel on Iran conflict escalation, directly pressuring equities through higher input costs. Treasury $6B buyback disappointed markets and drove yields higher, increasing pressure on long-duration growth names including NVDA (UPTREND) META (DISTRIBUTION) AMZN (DISTRIBUTION) MSFT (UPTREND) AAPL (DISTRIBUTION) GOOGL (DOWNTREND).
